records.name: Super Mad Dance
records.character_source: Gogeta (Super Saiyan) / Gogeta (Super Saiyan 4) customizable partner / SSGSS Gogeta / Gogeta (DB Super)
records.skill_description: A teleporting Strike Super combo that launches the opponent and can branch into additional kicks depending on directional input.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 reference documents an initial kick followed by teleporting follow-up attacks. Directional input changes the follow-up pattern; transformed versions can use an extended five-hit sequence. Exact frame and damage values are not promoted to canonical data.
records.acquisition_notes: Skill Shop is the documented Xenoverse 2 acquisition route. Independent player reports likewise identify the Skill Shop as the source.
records.pve_notes: Skill Shop acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Fast Strike combo with teleporting follow-ups and directional branching; detailed matchup and frame behavior remains version-sensitive.
